contentList.content: What exactly are you asking me to do?
What can we do to stop this?
I'm afraid the power to remove this parasite eludes me. I can't cure us.
Apology accepted. Who knows, I might have done the same were the roles reversed.
It's not enough to fight. You people are going to win.
A mind flayer?! Give me one reason not to kill you.
I found them. They didn't make it, Arabella...
Quiet while they leave. That's exactly what I plan on doing.
I can't let you do this, Shadowheart. I won't.
You owe me for dealing with the goblins at the gate. Release her. I'll see that she stays out of trouble.
